name: io.github.abangdwie/fx-macro
description: FX reference rates + euro-area macro data (ECB/Eurostat), pay-per-call in USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: fx_rates
tools.description: Get latest FX reference rates for a base currency (Frankfurter, blended reference rates from 112 central banks + official sources). Costs $0.002 USDC per call, paid via x402 on Base.

base.description: Base currency, ISO 4217 code, e.g. USD, EUR, IDR (default USD)

symbols.description: Comma-separated target currencies, max 20, e.g. IDR,EUR,GBP (empty = all currencies)

tools.name: fx_convert
tools.description: Convert an amount between two currencies at the reference rate. Costs $0.002 USDC per call, paid via x402 on Base.

from.description: Source currency, ISO 4217 code, e.g. USD

to.description: Target currency, ISO 4217 code, e.g. IDR

amount.description: Amount to convert; must be > 0 and <= 1e12 (default 1)

tools.name: fx_history
tools.description: Get daily historical FX rates over a window, with first/last rate and percent change. Costs $0.005 USDC per call, paid via x402 on Base.

base.description: Base currency, ISO 4217 code, e.g. USD (default USD)

symbols.description: Comma-separated target currencies, max 5, e.g. IDR,EUR (default IDR)

tools.name: macro_ecb
tools.description: Get euro-area macro indicators from ECB Statistical Data Warehouse + Eurostat: HICP inflation, real GDP, M3, ECB policy rates (MRO, DFR), unemployment. Partial delivery: if some series fail upstream, the successful ones are still returned and failed series listed as {code, error}, full $0.005 charged; only a total failure of all requested series returns an error with no charge. Costs $0.005 USDC per call, paid via x402 on Base.

series.description: Comma-separated series codes, e.g. HICP,GDP,M3,MRO,DFR,UNEMP (empty = all 6 series)

tools.name: health
tools.description: Check that the server is alive. Free, no payment required.

tools.name: catalog
tools.description: List all tools with their prices in USDC. Free, no payment required.
